The '''Jorrn Kresh gang''' was a criminal organization led by [[Jorrn Kresh]].<ref name="BH" /> Originally known as the '''Kressar gang''' under Boss [[Kressar]], Kresh wrested control of the organization and renamed it.<ref name="GG11" /> They attempted to force protection money out of [[Grison Jarn]].<ref name="BH" />
